decisive_items: Third Bone Marrow Biopsy: Near-total effacement of marrow by necrotic, high-grade tumor
Immunohistochemistry: Positive for CD2, cytoplasmic CD3, CD30, perforin, TIA-1; Negative for CD4, CD5, CD7, CD8, TCR-gamma, ALK-1
response.rationale: The marrow effacement by a high-grade tumor with T-cell markers (CD2, cytoplasmic CD3, perforin, TIA-1) and CD30 positivity, but ALK-1 negativity, supports a mature T-cell lymphoma. R2 is the most specific category fully supported by the immunophenotype; R1 (ALCL) is plausible but lacks morphological or ALK evidence to confirm that subtype. R3 is too broad.

rejected.why: Overly broad; does not specify the T-cell lineage indicated by the immunophenotype.
Specific ALCL diagnosis is not fully supported; ALK-1 negativity and lack of characteristic morphology make it less certain than a general T-cell lymphoma.
